item.title: New Technique Speeds Up AI Image Generation While Boosting Quality
item.description: Researchers combine distillation and reinforcement learning to create faster text-to-image models that align better with human preferences.

item.title: Helix4D Tackles Video-to-4D Mesh Generation's Hardest Problems
item.description: New framework handles transparent materials and complex topology shifts that have stymied previous video-to-4D systems.

item.title: New Framework Accelerates Development of Multimodal AI Models
item.description: Researchers release Prism, a modular toolkit designed to streamline continuous learning in vision-language systems without requiring code rewrites.

item.title: AI Research: Building Better Agent Architecture Beyond Raw Model Power
item.description: New research argues that scaling AI agents depends as much on system design as foundation model improvements.

item.title: New Framework Generates Photorealistic Driving Scenarios for AI Training
item.description: Researchers develop a controllable system that synthesizes complex traffic scenes from simple layouts, advancing autonomous vehicle safety testing.

item.title: New Platform Lets AI Agents Train on Mobile Apps at Scale
item.description: Researchers release MobileGym, enabling faster training of AI systems that navigate smartphone interfaces through parallel simulation.

item.title: New AI Method Turns 3D Scene Images Into Physics-Ready Models
item.description: TriSplat eliminates expensive post-processing steps by directly generating simulation-compatible meshes from sparse camera views.
